lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review argumentation by combining partial agreement, contrast, and a practical conclusion.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Discussing whether a local service should keep longer evening opening hours.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Responding to another view, balancing pros and cons, and reaching a conclusion.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a proposal for longer evening opening hours at a local service center.

main_focus.name: argument review with partial agreement and conclusion
main_focus.description: Combine agreement, concession, contrast, and conclusion markers in a coherent practical discussion.
model_examples: Jag håller delvis med, men kostnaden kan bli ett problem.
Sammanfattningsvis verkar längre öppettider vara bra om behovet är stort.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 2-3 partial-agreement phrases, 2-3 contrast/concession markers, and one clear conclusion.

allowed_supporting_grammar: balanced contrast with å ena sidan and å andra sidan

useful_chunks: Å ena sidan hjälper det många.
Å andra sidan kostar det mer.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Recycle Week 2 argumentation chunks in a concrete civic-service topic.

dialogue_shape.opening: A local proposal and one initial reaction are introduced.
dialogue_shape.middle: They balance benefits and drawbacks, respond to a counterargument, and mention a condition.
dialogue_shape.ending: They reach a cautious conclusion about the proposal.

target_complexity.repetition: review should integrate the week's argument patterns without adding new structures

focus: the cautious conclusion about the proposal

sentence_focus: one sentence with å ena sidan
one sentence with å andra sidan
one sentence giving a summary conclusion
